prompt:
A full-body character image, vertical 2:3 (1024×1536): Hua Xiong of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, reimagined as an adult woman — the fearsome general who fell before a cup of wine cooled.

1. STYLE
Korean MMORPG character artwork. A recognisably drawn face with gently simplified anatomical structure. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
Her face is small and soft: a short midface, a softly rounded jaw and a small chin, about 1.3 times as long as it is wide, with her eyes open at their natural size. Bangs, side locks and headpieces frame the face without lengthening it.
Skin finish: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

2. CHARACTER
Age: late twenties — a graceful grown-up face with soft, smooth contours.
Face — her own, recognisably this character, a woman's face with no beard or facial hair: a fierce, wild ferocity; fair skin; diamond-shaped face; large eyes — large round eyes, level outer eye corners; thick straight brows; upturned nose; full heart-shaped lips; honey-gold eyes; smoky dark eye makeup.
Body and hair: strong and broad-shouldered with firm muscle, yet full-busted with wide rounded hips and a defined waist build; a high topknot with long tails falling from it with center-parted bangs framing the face; soft lavender hair.
Expression: a faint knowing smile, subtle and relaxed.
Legend, carried in her design and bearing: brutal strength and pride, heavy dark armor.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME AND EQUIPMENT — MECHA
Costume: a female mecha personification built as an assault-type mecha frame — heavy armor plates, thruster packs, reinforced limbs, her weapon rebuilt as a large mecha armament. Solid hard-surface plates with visible joints cover her frame except at the openings named under Exposure; any cape or skirt is made of rigid armored plates; her face and hair stay human.
Silhouette: one long segmented mechanical tail reaching from the back of her waist, tipped with a weapon or ornament. This silhouette sets the overall shape of the costume above — keep its materials, ornaments and rank in this shape; the details are free.
Colours: blood crimson, black iron, tarnished gold and smoky grey. Faction frame: blood-crimson and black-iron plating with tarnished-gold trim, heavy tyrant's spiked silhouette with battle scars, smoky exhaust vents, crimson glow lines.
Signature item: a heavy saber, rebuilt as a far-future high-tech version of the same kind of object with the same silhouette — hard-surface alloy plates with panel lines, mechanical joints, vents and emitter nodes, an energy edge, plasma blade or glowing core in her glow-line colour and small status lights, with any animal motif re-sculpted as sleek machined armour. She holds it at full scale: one whole object, drawn once, held in front of or beside her body; a long weapon keeps one straight, unbroken shaft with a single head or blade.
Exposure (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — a bare waist and midriff between the bust plate and the hip armor, and bare upper thighs between the hip armor and thigh-high leg plates; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: year 2190, the Free Zones — a lawless asteroid belt between the three powers: warlord fortresses carved into asteroids, wrecked starships drifting in the dark, a violet nebula, warning lights blinking.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: a soft key light with a strong rim light tracing her hair, shoulders and armour; bright, crisp specular highlights on metal and jewellery, and a clean, warm-neutral sheen on her skin.
Composition: her whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet inside the frame with clear margins, about four-fifths of the image height; camera at chest height with natural portrait perspective.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only — no second character, horse or other creature. No readable text or numbers — emblems are abstract insignia shapes only, never letters or Chinese characters. No logo, watermark, speech bubble or frame border. A far-future setting only — space stations, starships and high-tech structures — with no traditional East-Asian architecture.
Avoid: a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin.

observations: Selected full-body world candidate, both arms and legs connected; no regeneration. Mecha weapon has an elongated pole-like hilt instead of a short saber hilt.
Finger contours partly overlap grips in some views; no clear extra limbs seen.
qa.cause: Visible deviation from wardrobe, framing, reference hair or setting constraint; preserved as generated.

acceptance: User authorized QA, commit and non-force main update. No exposure-based regeneration.
